name: painting-art
comment: WP-2.4. A stone wall at z = 3 (x -8..8, y 61-66). Four paintings by the position constructor (spawn Painting with direction, EntityPainting(world, x, y, z, dir), EntityPainting.java:22-45): every motive that fits is a candidate and one is drawn with rand.nextInt on the painting's own seeded rand (the oracle replays the draw, tests/golden/README.md); ids 0-2 on the wall's -z face (direction 0) at anchors x = -5, 0, 5 (y 63), id 3 on its +z face (direction 2) at x = 0. Later paintings exclude motives overlapping earlier ones (onValidSurface's painting scan). At t = 50 the anchor block of painting 0 is removed; on its 101st update (t = 100, tickCounter1) onValidSurface fails, the painting dies and drops a painting item (Math.random draws). A snowball (id 4) at (0.5, 64, -2) flies +z into painting 1 (the entity hit beats the wall behind it): EntityPainting.attackEntityFrom kills it and drops an item. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
